body: Independent amendment2 review confirms the original P1 4267187098 root cause is fixed in the working tree: both direct agent-browser calls receive explicit --cdp, and tab selection uses the stable CDP targetId. Port and target-token validation prevent option injection; arguments are quoted. The revised tests cover every prescribed failure path; 76 generator tests, ShellCheck and render-check pass. Real browser refresh latency remains for post-install verification.

P2: if the selected map tab closes between tab and eval, agent-browser may fall back to another tab and reload it, potentially losing unsaved input. Independent reviewer cited bundled tab help lines16-22. This local review comment is closed as an explicitly acknowledged advisory, not a code fix: orchestrator PING of2026-10-14T06:38:37Z directs exact amendment2 argv, no amendment3, and assigns this open code risk to dotfiles-T128-project-map-reload-hook-followup-a01 under the task P2 clause. The risk is preserved in report.md; integration and follow-up authority remain with the orchestrator.
